scenario: Side flip left upstream + major measurement and extent errors
description: Stage 3b call built from brain-mr/findings_gt/example_2.json and findings_pred/example_2.json. The putamen-metastasis pair differs only in side (right vs left putamen): the side is scored upstream (Stage 3a `laterality`), so it carries no site error. The pituitary pair has a comparison disagreement (gt worsening vs pred stable) that Stage 3a scores; Stage 3b does NOT re-emit comparison errors, but the pred leaves out the growth into a mass pressing on the optic chiasm, a major extent error (mass effect). The leptomeningeal tentorial mass is one finding with its edema on each side; it has a major measurement error (thickness 1.5 vs 2 cm: more than 20 % and 5 mm).

gt_finding.text: New metastasis measuring 17 mm in diameter in the left putamen with extensive perilesional edema.
